Phrase 7 (1:04.9) introduces E, centred on E. Phrase 9 (1:35.3) introduces B, centred on E. Phrase 13 (3:04.6) introduces Db, D, centred on A. Phrase 21 (6:09.3) introduces Fs, centred on E. The line peaks at Gb4 (375.4 Hz) at 2:16.2. It closes on the tonic (Fs4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → A3 → A3).
